delivery_commit_subject: feat: show audited world spawn rule summaries in wiki

results.name: Namespaced rules are read from the loaded pool and all rule/group cards paginate without loss
Biome IDs/tags, declared dimension and both day ranges are preserved; exclusions remain separate
Declared form and Minecraft tick ranges are shown without inventing a default form or a spawn prediction
Disabled spawn set is absent; a known empty result is distinct from consultation failure
Spawn inspection is read only: no paper icons or official progress changes
Native rules resolve correctly and old spawn-page actions recheck current permission
Reload revalidates a stale species/rule view instead of exposing old collection data
Restart after fixture removal clears old rules and reports no known simple rule, not an unavailable source
Native loaded-world rules remain queryable after custom rules are removed
Collection button opens a dynamic wiki; pagination is stable and reversible
Wiki supports deterministic ordering by identifier
Search accepts canonical names and case-insensitive namespaced IDs; details show real forms/types and explicit unknown spawn/capture data
Empty results, reset, valid unimplemented species and oversized search have explicit bounded behavior
Collection filters and shiny-unavailable semantics are preserved; browsing and discard do not mutate official progress or give icons
Seen/obtained/unseen/shiny-seen filters track official Cobblemon events without treating granted Pokémon as verified shiny captures
Restricted wiki commands and stale species buttons enforce current LuckPerms permissions
Stale wiki navigation revalidates reloaded collection criteria and returns safely to the collection

with_fixture: [12:14:46] [Server thread/INFO] (Minecraft) ThreadedAnvilChunkStorage: All dimensions are saved
after_removal: [12:17:27] [Server thread/INFO] (Minecraft) ThreadedAnvilChunkStorage: All dimensions are saved

audited_facts: Only loaded world-pool PokemonSpawnDetail declarations are summarized; enabled=false fixture is absent.
Resolve namespaced species by PokemonSpecies.getByIdentifier, not getByName.
Keep biome IDs and #tag selectors raw; dimensions are declared IDs.
Positive condition groups remain separate from anticonditions; composite conditions flagged without interpretation.
Declared form preserved; applicability to selected forms/aspects not inferred.
corrected_attempts: Initial getByName resolution double-prefixed namespaced fixture species; corrected to getByIdentifier and retested.
Reload runner expected a different species despite retained search; assertion corrected to empty results with original search.
limits: No actual Pokemon spawn was invoked or verified.
No universal coverage: composite/global rules, custom selectors, weather/light/height/weights, herd/NPC/third-party spawners not fully interpreted.
No known supported rule differs from unavailable source; neither proves universal absence of natural spawn.
No visual client/load/new packaged alpha outside Loom verification.
Snapshot lifecycle/data-pack reload paths implemented; data-pack removal verified across restarts, not live registry hot reload.
No new release or environment configuration publication.
